svg.title: Put/call OI tile: before and after
svg.desc: Before: the AAPL tile for expiry 2026-12-04 reads No ratio because 2 of 146 contracts have no open interest value. After (UI mock): the tile shows 1.13 from the reported open interest and names the coverage. Below: lowest side coverage of 48 live chains measured 2026-11-26 03:27 to 03:50 UTC against the 50 percent floor; a ratio shows for 15 of 48 chains before and 40 of 48 after. The 8 chains below the floor have 40 percent or less.
